name: JetonRouter
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs explorer label and description.
rootCause: JetonRouter, an Ethereum swap routing contract, was exploited on April 27, 2026 for approximately $229K. The TenArmorAlert security monitoring service flagged the suspicious on-chain activity. No public post-mortem or detailed technical disclosure has been published for this incident; the specific vulnerability in the router's execution path has not been publicly documented. Attack Tx: 0x57709a498f27c7219b634ae20e7d2cbf9ab8dd6aca7b3845fabf93b57760b576 Analysis: TenArmorAlert on X
